name: Nova Pro
description: Amazon's most capable model balancing accuracy, speed, and cost.
longDescription: Amazon Nova Pro is a highly capable multimodal model that offers the best combination of accuracy, speed, and cost among the Nova family. It processes text, images, and video inputs and is optimized for a wide range of tasks from analysis to content generation.

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
import boto3
import json

client = boto3.client("bedrock-runtime")
response = client.invoke_model(
    modelId="amazon.nova-pro-v1:0",
    body=json.dumps({"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": [{"text": "Hello!"}]}]})
)
result = json.loads(response["body"].read())
print(result["output"]["message"]["content"][0]["text"])
